item.title: From Climate to Security: The New Drivers of Energy Innovation
item.description: The global energy innovation landscape is undergoing a structural transformation. While climate mitigation remains the central inspiration to energy innovation, the primary forces shaping research, funding and policy in 2026 are energy security and economic competitiveness. item.description: An indigenously developed 30 kW Wide Band Gap (WBG)-based Integrated Drive System (IDS) for electric vehicles was unveiled in Chennai on Monday, marking a fresh push toward strengthening India’s domestic power electronics ecosystem. item.title: Tata.ev Partners with Hopcharge to Launch Doorstep EV Charging in NCR
item.description: Tata Motors’ electric vehicle arm, Tata.ev, has partnered with mobile charging solutions provider Hopcharge to roll out on-demand charging vans across the National Capital Region (NCR), aiming to make EV charging more accessible for urban customers. The initiative introduces doorstep charging services, allowing electric vehicle owners to summon a charging van to their location instead of travelling to a public EV charging station or relying on a fixed home charger. item.title: Modi Inaugurates ₹3,600 Crore Powergrid Projects to Boost Renewable Evacuation in Rajasthan
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi on Monday inaugurated two major power transmission projects in Rajasthan worth over ₹3,600 crore, developed by Power Grid Corporation of India Limited (Powergrid). The commissioning marks a significant step in enhancing the evacuation of renewable power from Rajasthan’s high-capacity solar and wind zones to demand centres across the country. item.title: Sahjanand Green, Army Solar, Best Apartment Foray Into MNRE’s ALMM (Modules)
item.description: The Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE) has issued its latest Approved List of Models and Manufacturers (ALMM) for solar modules. The updated list includes six new entrants, most of which are based in Gujarat and Rajasthan. The new entrants into the ALMM (Modules) include Vikram Solar’s Tamil Nadu plant, Army Solar, Sahjanand Green Energy, Best Apartment Pvt Ltd, Rajdeep Solar, and Startup Energy. item.title: NTPC REL Awards 300 MW Solar EPC Project in NTPC Anta, Rajasthan To Enrich
item.description: Enrich has bagged an award for a 300 MW Solar EPC Project from NTPC Renewable Energy Limited (NTPC REL), to be developed at NTPC Anta, Rajasthan. Enrich Energy said in a post that it has signed the turnkey contract with the NTPC Renewable Energy arm, NTPC REL project, further strengthening Enrich’s growing portfolio in large-scale utility solar projects. item.title: MoP Proposes Smart Pre-Payment Meters to Cut Late Payment Surcharges, Boost DISCOM Efficiency
item.description: The Ministry of Power (MoP) has recently proposed implementing smart pre-payment meters.
